Havens-West — Amsterdam, Netherlands

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Havens-West is one of Amsterdam's 110 official wijken (CBS/gemeente boundaries). CBS (Statistics Netherlands) recorded 208 registered crimes here in 2025 across a population of 30 residents — a rate of 693,333 crimes per 100,000 residents, roughly 40.0× the citywide wijk average. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area (like the city centre) can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential wijk can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This wijk has a small registered population (30 residents), so its rate per 100,000 residents can swing sharply from a handful of cases and should be read with that in mind rather than as a stable per-visit risk measure. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Amsterdam — real CBS crime and population statistics, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Havens-West safe?

Wandroz currently rates Havens-West in Amsterdam, Netherlands as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Havens-West safe at night?

At night, Havens-West is rated as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Havens-West a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Havens-West's day rating (an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Havens-West?

Not yet at neighbourhood level. Unlike London, this city does not currently publish an open, geolocated crime dataset at this level of detail (checked against the relevant local and national open-data portals — see the methodology page for what was checked).
